claim_one_line: THE WALLS TRACE TO A6 -- THE SQUARING BUYS ORIENTABILITY AND COSTS EVERY VALUE. Owner: 'maybe at some point we followed a wrong sub-branch on our math, that built the walls around us... the thing here is not whether our idea derives reality but whether we're clever enough to see how.' Tested, not assumed. THE JOIN: eight banked walls -- no dimensionful quantity / blindness to k (B1012/B1088), CS = 0 (B1224/B1227), chirality not self-supplied (B713/B760), the CP sign external (B285/B340), the naming wall (B1225), box D pays in bits (B1226), the trivial value-kernel (B1029), and no-forced-choice (B130/K013) -- ALL pass through ONE upstream fact: THE MIRROR IS A SELF-ISOMETRY OF THE OBJECT, i.e. AMPHICHIRALITY. It is not one wall among eight; it is what the other eight are downstream of. CELL 1, THE DECISIVE COMPUTATION: amphichirality is FORCED BY THE CONSTRUCTION, not found in the object. Orientation double covers of the non-orientable cusped census: 40 OF 40 AMPHICHIRAL = 100%. Two-sided control: the base rate among orientable 1-cusped census manifolds is 6 OF 200 = 3.0%. An orientation double cover carries the deck transformation that reverses orientation, so it is amphichiral by construction. CELL 2: m004 IS the orientation double cover of the Gieseking manifold m000 -- verified by is_isometric_to, with volume ratio exactly 2.000000 and m000 non-orientable. CELL 3: THE ARITHMETIC DOES NOT NEED A6. pi_1(Gieseking) surjects onto 2T with 48 SURJECTIONS -- IDENTICAL to m004's 48 -- and Gieseking sits in the same disc -3 commensurability class, hence has the same invariant trace field Q(sqrt-3). So the route trace field -> 2T -> McKay -> E6 -> the cascade runs WITHOUT the squaring. THE CHAIN: A6 ('take M^2, the orientable one'; M has det -1, M^2 has det +1) => orientation double cover => amphichiral (100%-forced) => all eight walls. A6 IS A CHOICE, and P019 already labels it [AXIOM]; B749 already priced its fork F5 as FRAGILE, naming the det -1 sibling as the Gieseking. THE RECORD PRICED THE CHOICE AND NEVER CONNECTED IT TO THE WALLS. That edge is the finding -- the same lost-edge class as B1227. WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES: the walls are properties of A CHOICE MADE AT LINK 6, NOT of 'the minimal something', and the record has been reading them as the latter for two years. A theorem about a choice is a different epistemic object from a theorem about existence. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH, and must not be read as: that dropping A6 makes values derivable. A non-orientable object may not support the machinery at all -- Chern-Simons, the complex volume and the SL(2,C) representation theory all USE orientation -- so dropping A6 may BREAK THE TOOLS rather than open a door. That is the live question, and it is now a sharp one. Also unclaimed: any specificity for Gieseking (B993/B996: surjecting onto 2T is generic at ~1/3, so the equal counts are not evidence of distinction -- the point is only that A6 was not NEEDED for the arithmetic). Gate 5 intact; nothing promoted; no measured value asserted.
